items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-13
items.q: Then there was myself, Sheik and Peter Boccage and this fella, Baptiste, on trumpet. ... Noel was on snare and Booker T. On bass drum.

ctx.x: Jules Cahn took some photos and he also took a movie of some of it. Who was in the band, by the way? There was a fella called Brown on Tuba. I don't know his name. Little fella. William Grant. They just call him Brown. Manuel Paul and Andrew Morgan on tenors. Two tenors. No clarinet. I think Andrew Morgan was supposed to play clarinet. I think they expected him to, but he turned up with his tenor. So there were two tenors. Chicken Henry and Earl Humphrey. Booker T. And his son, Papa, I think, what's his name?…
